episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: When a teen sports star dies, the community of Sanctuary is shattered; DCI Knight expects a straightforward investigation but the response of Harper, daughter of a local witch, leads her to suspect there's more to his death than meets the eye.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: When non-witch daughter Harper is accused of murder, Sarah must use her magic to prove her innocence; fueled by local resentments, suspicions transfer to mother and daughter, while Abigail tries to blackmail Sarah with an extraordinary demand.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: An expert confirms that magic was present at the crime scene. Harper makes a shocking revelation to Sarah who warns that her disclosure, if revealed to the police, will make her a suspect. An accusation from Harper sends Abigail into revenge mode.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Harper's accusations put suspicion onto her and Sarah, and a memorial vigil incites ill feeling.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Following the dunking, Sarah decides to cast a spell over the whole of Sanctuary. A revelation pushes Abi into action.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Abigail seeks to clear Dan's name by whipping up anti-witch feeling amidst a mystery virus and evidence of dark magic.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: With Sanctuary cut off from the outside world, Abigail has free rein to exact the ultimate revenge on Sarah and Harper.

episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Sarah Fenn returns to Sanctuary, but a horrific magical murder complicates her efforts at reintegration.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: Sarah and Maggie make a startling magical discovery.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Sarah and Maggie determine that Angela has the most to gain from the murder and agree that they need more evidence; a magical attack on Harper forces Sarah to betray Maggie; following the attack, Sarah rekindles her romance with Lachlan.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: Sarah and Maggie prove Lachlan innocent after his arrest.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: The killer strikes again and Sarah saves an unbound Lachlan.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Angela's bill passes into law as Sarah embraces her destiny.
